text_to_translate.description: The text content to be translated.

source_language_code.description: The ISO 639-1 code of the source language (e.g., 'en' for English, 'es' for Spanish).

target_language_code.description: The ISO 639-1 code of the target language (e.g., 'fr' for French, 'de' for German).

formal_tone.description: Set to true if a formal tone is preferred in the translation, false otherwise. Defaults to false.

function.name: get_supported_languages
function.description: Retrieves a list of all language codes and their human-readable names that are supported by the translation service.

language_name_filter.description: An optional filter to search for languages by their human-readable name (e.g., 'English'). Case-insensitive.

language_code_filter.description: An optional filter to search for languages by their ISO 639-1 code (e.g., 'es').

function.name: queue_document_translation
function.description: Submits a document for asynchronous translation. This is suitable for larger files or batches of text that require longer processing times. The translation will be processed in the background.

document_id.description: A unique identifier for the document to be translated. This ID can be used later to check the status or retrieve the translated document.

source_language_code.description: The ISO 639-1 code of the source language of the document.

target_language_code.description: The ISO 639-1 code of the target language for the document.

callback_url.description: An optional URL to which a notification will be sent upon completion of the translation.

priority.description: The priority level for the translation job, where higher numbers indicate higher priority (e.g., 1-5). Defaults to 3.

function.name: get_translation_job_status
function.description: Checks the current status of a previously submitted document translation job using its job ID.

job_id.description: The unique identifier of the translation job.

function.name: retrieve_translated_document
function.description: Retrieves the translated content of a document that was previously submitted and completed. This will return the translated document's content or a link to it.

job_id.description: The unique identifier of the completed translation job.

output_format.description: The desired format for the output document (e.g., 'plain_text', 'html', 'pdf'). Defaults to 'plain_text'.

function.name: update_translation_memory
function.description: Updates or adds a new entry to the translation memory for a specific language pair. This helps improve consistency and accuracy for future translations.

source_segment.description: The original text segment in the source language.

target_segment.description: The corresponding translated text segment in the target language.

source_language_code.description: The ISO 639-1 code of the source language.

target_language_code.description: The ISO 639-1 code of the target language.

domain.description: An optional domain or context for this translation memory entry (e.g., 'legal', 'medical', 'technical').

overwrite_existing.description: If true, overwrites an existing entry if source_segment, target_segment, and language codes match. Defaults to false.
